answer_verbatim:
For **shadow work with a strong spiritual or depth-psychology angle**, the most credible options in your results are **Jung Platform’s courses** and **Insight Timer’s meditation-based courses**.[12][14][17] For a more structured, certificate-style course, **Centre of Excellence’s Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** and several **Udemy** options are available, though they appear more general and less clinically/depth-psychology oriented.[1][2][3]

Here’s a practical shortlist:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | Serious Jungian shadow work | Described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology series.[14] |
| **Shadow courses** (Jung Platform) | Deeper study of shadow and self-understanding | Offers six in-depth courses and talks, with topics including personal vs. collective shadow and authenticity.[12] |
| **Engage the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | Practical application | Includes 10 video and 10 audio recordings and emphasizes practical shadow work techniques.[18] |
| **Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing and Growth** (Insight Timer) | Gentle, guided healing practice | Focuses on uncovering and healing hidden parts of yourself through a meditation-course format.[4] |
| **Mindful Shadow Work: For Unconditional Self Love** (Insight Timer) | Spiritual self-compassion | A mindfulness-oriented approach that fits spiritual practice and self-love work.[15] |
| **Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** (Centre of Excellence) | Structured online learning | A formal course option focused on shadow work exercises and online study.[1] |

If you want the **best overall match for spiritual practice**, I’d prioritize these in order:

1. **Jung Platform – Encounters with the Shadow** for the most grounded depth-psychology approach.[14]  
2. **Jung Platform – Shadow courses** if you want a fuller curriculum.[12]  
3. **Insight Timer – Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing and Growth** if you want a more meditative, guided spiritual style.[4]  
4. **Insight Timer – Mindful Shadow Work: For Unconditional Self Love** for a softer self-compassion emphasis.[15]  
5. **Udemy – Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self Certification** if you want a broad, accessible intro with a self-development focus.[2]

A useful way to choose is:

- **Choose Jung Platform** if you want **Jungian depth psychology**, authenticity, dreams, and a more contemplative framework.[12][14][17]
- **Choose Insight Timer** if you want **meditation-led spiritual practice** and gentle guided exercises.[4][15]
- **Choose Udemy or Centre of Excellence** if you want a **more affordable, general self-paced course** with a broader audience focus.[1][2][3][6]

If you want, I can also rank these by **best for beginners, best for spiritual growth, and best value for money**.
